label: preparing
what: A coordinated gathering in the great hall at eighteen hundred, with privately funded bread and refreshments, repaired lighting, and the secretary escorting me. Its booking and hospitality are now disclosed, but the innkeeper originally withheld details until the hour. It may be a celebration of my forty years as mayor, though that purpose is not confirmed. Secretary knowingly helps with booking and escort; baker supplies bread, but may not know the concealed purpose.
